notes.title: Crafting & Corrupt Update 0.8.870
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/43e6d0a41266f71cd26d053caf310f04eaaa849b.png[/img]

[h1]Crafting & Corrupt Update 0.8.870[/h1]

[b]New Features[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/3da9a59c02a5adc278dff23e9b3ac2d9095551e3.png[/img]

- Crafting UI Overhaul
+ Weapons and shields can now be crafted without purchasing their blueprints.
+ Crafting a certain number of weapons and shields unlocks the next tier of blacksmith.
+ Crafting categories have been subdivided.
+ After repairing the blacksmith, a craft button will appear in the bottom right corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/5dc8f756e234260667eb4cf81234ee34b14b4d4e.png[/img]

- Added Corrupted Monsters
- Added 2 types of Corrupted Dungeons
- Added various textures for Corrupted Liquid
+ When Corrupted Liquid spreads, it may spawn Corrupted Dungeons or Corrupted Monsters.
+ These will not spawn if the curse level is low.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/ebd77bb1f08c601e09690c20f34feb12afd9a64e.png[/img]

- Added UI display for owned core items.
- Having a Core of Power increases all adventurers' attack by 2.
- Having a Core of Decoration increases all adventurers' defense by 2.
- Core items are no longer shown in the inventory.
- The hospital can now be upgraded further.
- Changed the required items for hospital upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/6c301fa29c4608d9f909d56b80d1f271c54bb478.png[/img]

- Updated the adventurer list UI to display adventurer status more clearly.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Corrupted Liquid now spreads more slowly.
- [Curse Filter] speed increased.
- [Advanced Curse Filter] speed increased.
- Increased prices for [Curse Filter] and [Advanced Curse Filter]
- [Curse Filter] and [Advanced Curse Filter] now emit light.
- Optimized thread string comparisons.
- Removed crafting guide from the guild building.
- Removed the crafting category from the inventory.
- Renamed the clothing shop.
- Increased experience gain rate for all adventurers.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed adventurer placement was canceled even though they weren’t knocked out.
- Fixed hospital UI.
- Fixed crafted items were not recognized as crafted.
- Fixed the UI wouldn't refresh after repairing the forge.
- Fixed incorrect time display in the hospital.
- Fixed hospital level synchronization issues.
- Fixed some shop UIs kept refreshing in multiplayer.

notes.title: Golden Update (0.8.738)
notes.notes:
[b]0.8.738 Golden Update[/b]

[i]Hello, Players!
This update includes balance adjustments, new items and buildings, as well as various improvements.[/i]


[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Added new item [b]Gold powder[/b]
- Added [b]Golden crops[/b]
- Added [b]Gold Grinder[/b]


How to get golden crops?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/863d5b388738562889bb3bc3d06a640dbc3653f3.png[/img]
In [Research], you need to research the [Production] - [Gold Grinder] object to obtain gold powder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/536296b303c415f968148378c589b27bbac78f5c.png[/img]
Once you have obtained gold powder, you will be able to select the Gold powder mode in the drone settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/4a8cbfff58e88172b89fbfcf316afdb7ae275f55.png[/img]
Crops sprinkled with gold powder have a chance to grow into golden crops.
Golden crops can be sold at a high price in the shop building.



- Modified the drone's range setting graphics.
- Changed the drone UI to display the number of tiles set as the drone's range.
- Changed the drone's movement system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/b4793ebba96376dd54012961565080153d22552f.png[/img]
The drone's movement system has been changed.
While its move time efficiency has improved, it now consumes more power, so speed adjustment may be necessary.



- Removed Search in Adventurer's list
- Added Sort of Work building system in Adventurer's list

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040105/c37d34beef41e0603290078b6e4393e6d89da812.png[/img]
You can see which adventurer is assigned to a building based on the buildings you have placed.


- Changed the research requirement for the Wind generator to gold.
- Increased the speed of the cooking object.
- Increased the installation cost of the hospital.
- Adjusted the watermill's power production speed to 55 seconds.
- Changed the watermill’s power production - 3 to 4 units.
- Reduced the growth speed of carrots.
- Reduced the growth speed of potatoes.
- Increased the prices of food items.
- Increased the price of wool.
- Reduced the first boss appearance date from day 30 to day 25.
- Increased the maximum number of monsters from 25 to 50.
- Increased the UI ratio's maximum size for 4K resolution.
- Limited the maximum number of items without warehouse restrictions to 1,000,000.



[b]Fixed[/b]
- Fixed the issue where the sounds of monsters in the underground dungeon could be heard when the player was in a different world.
- Fixed monster list UI error.
- Fixed the bug where the reputation display was slow.
- Added some missing languages.
- Changed so that the player can right-click to unequip equipment.
- Modified so that unequipped player equipment is added to the inventory.

- Fixed typos.
- Fixed the bug where the camera got stuck when clicking a monster in the monster list, making it impossible to move the camera with the movement keys.
- Fixed UI disappear bug.
- Changed the minimum system requirement to GTX 970.
- Fixed the UI graphics bug on HDR monitors.
- Fixed all the menus in the restaurant showed as "NONE" when restaurant building is placed first time.
- Disabled the use of emotes while fishing.
- Fixed the icon for fully grown crops was displayed as a different item.
- Fixed the boss's attack target remained permanently.
- Fixed the drone kept consuming movement power when it was in the same spot.
- Fixed the bug where some adventurers didn't disappear properly on the client.

Thank you for playing.
